decisions.reason: A spring-controlled flap weir sits squarely within the firm's hydraulic steel and weir engineering know-how, and the firm runs its own R&D with university links, so it can interpret early market feedback and refine the product rather than abandon it.

An energy management system for water facilities builds on the firm's automation software and project experience and matches its strategic push toward digital networking and energy efficiency, so its absorptive capacity supports continued development despite only a brief website mention.

The overflow flap gate line is close to the core offer, has several models and its own website page, signalling commitment, and the firm's related knowledge lets it assimilate customer feedback and improve the line.
